chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl bin Ziyad, from Ja'far bin Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'We, the group of Qureysh, are a meat-loving people'.
ai.seo_question: What characteristic trait did the Prophet attribute to the Quraysh tribe?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi, transmitted through the chain of Ja'far al-Sadiq, highlights the Quraysh's inherent predilection for meat, a trait often interpreted by Shia scholars as a physical manifestation of their tribal strength and status. It serves as a foundational context for understanding dietary etiquettes and the permissibility of meat consumption within the broader framework of prophetic tradition.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘We the group of Qureysh are a meat-loving people’.
en.sarwar: 9. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad al-Ash‘ariy from ibn al-Qaddah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
We members of Quraysh people like meat a great deal.’”
